claude-sonnet-4.basis: Estimated. Claude Sonnet 4 (distinct from Claude 3.5 Sonnet). No Jegham measurement. Proxied from Claude 3.5 Sonnet values (similar architecture class and pricing). Tier 3 ±1000%.

gemini-1.5-pro.basis: MoE architecture (~500B total, ~100B active per token).

gemini-2.0-flash.basis: Tier 3 - Google Environmental Report (Aug 2025) gives a full-stack median Gemini Apps text-prompt anchor of 0.24 Wh, not per-token coefficients. Values here are a provisional reverse-engineering assuming 1600 token median (800 in, 800 out), PUE 1.10, and 3:1 output/input ratio. If the median prompt is shorter (e.g., 400 tokens), coefficients could be ~4x higher. Cloud-optimized hyperscale batching; long context (>128k): +40% due to KV-cache memory pressure. Treat as order-of-magnitude until Google or independent work publishes per-token Gemini measurements. Source: https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/infrastructure/measuring-the-environmental-impact-of-ai-inference/

gemini-2.5-flash.basis: Estimated. No published energy figures or Jegham measurement for Gemini 2.5 Flash. Value proxied from Gemini 2.0 Flash (same order of magnitude). Efficiency direction vs 2.0 Flash is uncertain — increased capability may offset architectural gains. Use VETCH_REGION + live grid data for any carbon commitments. Tier 3 ±1000%.

gemini-2.5-pro.basis: Estimated. No published energy figures or Jegham measurement for Gemini 2.5 Pro. Value proxied from Gemini 1.5 Pro (same frontier MoE tier). Efficiency direction vs 1.5 Pro is uncertain. Tier 3 ±1000%.
